experiences.name: Prague Old Town & Astronomical Clock Tour
experiences.description: Arrive in Prague by early afternoon and dive straight into the historic heart of the city. Explore the medieval Old Town Square, watch the famous Astronomical Clock chime on the hour, and wander through Gothic alleyways. A self-guided walk keeps costs low while maximizing your first full day of culture and history.

experiences.name: Prague Castle Complex & St. Vitus Cathedral
experiences.description: Spend a morning exploring the largest ancient castle complex in the world. Walk through the Royal Palace, marvel at the Gothic grandeur of St. Vitus Cathedral, and enjoy panoramic views over the red rooftops of Prague. Book tickets in advance to save time and money.

experiences.name: Budapest Thermal Bath Experience at Széchenyi
experiences.description: After the train journey from Prague to Budapest, unwind in one of Europe's most iconic thermal bath complexes. The neo-baroque Széchenyi Baths offer indoor and outdoor pools fed by natural hot springs, a perfect cultural and restorative experience deeply rooted in Hungarian tradition.

experiences.name: Budapest Ruin Bar Crawl in the Jewish Quarter
experiences.description: Explore Budapest's unique ruin bar scene, born from abandoned buildings transformed into eclectic cultural and social hubs. Start at the iconic Szimpla Kert and wander through the historic Jewish Quarter, soaking in local art, street food, and the vibrant nightlife that defines modern Budapest culture.

experiences.name: Danube River Cruise with Parliament Views
experiences.description: Take an evening cruise along the Danube to witness Budapest's stunning illuminated skyline, including the Hungarian Parliament Building, Buda Castle, and the Chain Bridge. This iconic experience captures the grandeur of Budapest's history and architecture from the water, making it a highlight of any city-hopping itinerary.
